Q01.answer: Yes. ISO 9001:2015, cert. no. QMS/IN/48812, valid to 14-Mar-2028; covers Hoskote and Hosur.

Q02.answer: Yes. FSC CoC FSC-C1xxxx (mixed credit), valid to 2029.

Q03.answer: Yes. 70-85% recycled on domestic grades, 50%+ on export grades; declaration with each lot.

Q04.answer: 36,000 MTPA installed across two plants; utilisation ~72%.

Q06.answer: Yes. Lot code ink-jetted on every carton; traceable to reel numbers through ERP.

Q07.answer: 12 days for repeat items; 18 days for die-cut items.

Q08.answer: Acknowledgement within 24 h; CAPA within 7 days.

Q09.answer: Hoskote (approx. 15 km to SCPL BLR) and Hosur (approx. 70 km to SCPL BLR). Pune and Hyderabad served by road from Hoskote.

Q10.answer: Yes. Two plants act as mutual back-up, 20 days paper stock, contracts with 4 kraft mills.

Q11.answer: Yes. In-house aqueous WR coating; Cobb(30) 30-38 g/m2.

Q12.answer: Flexo up to 4 colours in-house. Litho-lamination through partner (Prism Offset, Bengaluru).

Q13.answer: ISO 14001:2015; ETP, 100% trim recycling, annual GHG report.

Q14.answer: Pest control by licensed agency and GMP; no BRCGS/ISO 22000 certification.
